defaults.accessibility: Decorative icons are aria-hidden. Meaningful icons require a visible label or an aria-label.

namespaces.activity: Generic actions that can happen inside or between engagements.
namespaces.engagement: Reserved Frontira offer and engagement markers.
namespaces.orchestration: Ordered work, automation and delivery flow.
namespaces.people: People, teams and accountable human roles.
namespaces.systems: Connections between software and operational systems.

activity.handoff.label: Handoff
activity.handoff.usage: Generic transfer of work or context between actors or systems.

activity.meeting.label: Meeting
activity.meeting.usage: Generic meeting or working session. Never a named Frontira engagement.

activity.review.label: Review
activity.review.usage: Generic review, quality gate or assessment activity.

activity.workshop.label: Workshop
activity.workshop.usage: Generic facilitated workshop. Never substitutes for a named engagement.

data.database.label: Database
data.database.usage: Structured operational data or a database system.

data.storage.label: Storage
data.storage.usage: File, object or durable system storage.

engagement.exploration.label: Exploration
engagement.exploration.usage: Reserved for the named Frontira Exploration engagement.

engagement.inspiration.label: Inspiration
engagement.inspiration.usage: Reserved for the named Frontira Inspiration engagement.

engagement.scoping.label: Scoping
engagement.scoping.usage: Reserved for the named Frontira Scoping engagement.

engagement.sprint.label: Agentic AI Sprint
engagement.sprint.usage: Reserved for the named Frontira Agentic AI Sprint delivery engagement.

governance.control.label: Governance
governance.control.usage: Authority, permission, control or governed execution.

governance.approval.label: Approval
governance.approval.usage: A recorded decision that authorizes work to proceed.

governance.audit.label: Audit
governance.audit.usage: A traceable inspection of evidence, actions or controls.

governance.escalation.label: Escalation
governance.escalation.usage: An exception or decision elevated to a higher authority.

governance.permission.label: Permission
governance.permission.usage: An access grant, restriction or authorization boundary.

governance.proof.label: Proof
governance.proof.usage: Verified outcome, evidence or completed quality gate.

governance.readiness.label: Readiness
governance.readiness.usage: A capability, workflow or case assessed as ready to proceed.

intelligence.agent.label: AI agent
intelligence.agent.usage: A bounded software agent, not AI as a decorative concept.

interface.app.label: Interface
interface.app.usage: A browser, application or human-facing interface.

interface.message.label: Message
interface.message.usage: A written message, conversation or communication channel.

orchestration.workflow.label: Workflow
orchestration.workflow.usage: Ordered work, automation or process orchestration.

people.team.label: Users and team
people.team.usage: A team, group of users or accountable human participants.

people.owner.label: Owner
people.owner.usage: The individually accountable human owner of work or a decision.

systems.integration.label: Integration
systems.integration.usage: Connected software, API integration or system interoperability.
